nodes.label: Placeholder Image
nodes.description: Generic 1200x1200 light-gray placeholder graphic: concentric circles with faded crosshair and diagonal guide lines, and a small dark 'image/picture' glyph (mountain + sun frame) at the center. Used as a fallback asset for missing images in the Banrisul frontend (typical Vite/shadcn scaffold default).
nodes.rationale: Neutral gray placeholder so layouts render with a visible image slot before real content/images are available.
